title: The Dare
alt: Ethan hesitates with a flashlight while Leo eagerly leads the way down the basement stairs during a storm.
caption: Leo’s excitement draws cautious Ethan into the dark basement.

title: The Descent
alt: Ethan and Leo explore a dusty basement filled with cobwebbed shelves, old jars, tools, and boxes.
caption: The brothers descend into a basement crowded with forgotten things.

title: Relics of the Past
alt: Ethan and Leo discover their grandfather’s sailor photograph, medals, journals, and a hidden locked chest.
caption: Grandpa’s old relics reveal the first clues to his secret past.

title: The Chest
alt: Leo lifts the lid of an antique chest as Ethan watches a dusty oilcloth bundle appear inside.
caption: The broken lock gives way, revealing a mysterious wrapped bundle.

title: The Map
alt: Ethan and Leo kneel beside the open chest and study an old map marked with islands, spirals, and stars.
caption: A fragile map turns Grandpa’s hidden past into a new adventure.

title: The Hook
alt: Ethan holds the folded map while he and Leo shine a flashlight toward a creak in the empty basement.
caption: A sudden creak makes the brothers wonder whether they awakened a secret.

title: The Uneasy Silence
alt: Ethan grips the map and flashlight while he and Leo stand uneasily among old medals, photographs, and trunks.
caption: The basement’s heavy silence finally dims even Leo’s brave grin.

title: The Whisper in the Dark
alt: A draft spins dust through Ethan’s flashlight beam as he guides Leo toward the basement stairs.
caption: A whisper-like draft sends the brothers hurrying for the stairs.

title: The Escape
alt: Outside the closed basement door, Ethan holds the map over his open backpack while Leo catches his breath.
caption: Safe upstairs, Ethan and Leo realize their adventure has only begun.
